poster_title: InfiFusion: A Unified Framework for Enhanced Cross-Model Reasoning via LLM Fusion
authors: Zhaoyi Yan, Yiming Zhang, Baoyi He, Yuhao Fu, Qi Zhou, Zhijie Sang, Chunlin Ji, Shengyu Zhang, Fei Wu, Hongxia Yang
paper_info: 2024, Reallm Labs, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Zhejiang University, Harbin Institute of Technology

panels.headline: LLMs excel in various tasks but no single model excels in all domains.
content: LLMs have shown success in various tasks but no single model excels in all domains.
Training a comprehensive model from scratch requires significant computational resources.
Traditional fusion methods rely on direct integration of model parameters, which assumes uniform architectures and often fails to capture diverse strengths.
Knowledge distillation methods are limited by vocabulary and token alignment issues.
Current LLM fusion methods are limited by rigid assumptions and inefficiencies.

panels.headline: Traditional methods fail to effectively integrate the strengths of diverse domain-specialized models.
content: Current LLM fusion methods are limited by rigid assumptions and inefficiencies.
Traditional methods fail to effectively integrate the strengths of diverse domain-specialized models.
Knowledge distillation methods are sensitive to vocabulary and token alignment, reducing their applicability.

panels.headline: InfiFusion enhances ULD with Top-K selection and Logits Standardization.
content: InfiFusion enhances Universal Logit Distillation (ULD) with Top-K selection and Logits Standardization.
Top-K selection filters out irrelevant logits, reducing noise and computational cost.
Logits Standardization ensures better alignment between models by normalizing logits across diverse models.
Two fusion strategies are proposed: Pairwise Fusion (InfiFusion p) and Unified Fusion (InfiFusion u).
panels.figure_caption: Illustration of the InfiFusion framework, incorporating Top-K selection and logits standardization. Two fusion strategies are proposed: Pairwise Fusion and Unified Fusion.

panels.headline: InfiFusion outperformed state-of-the-art models across all 11 benchmarks.
content: Experiments were conducted on 11 widely applied benchmarks covering reasoning, coding, mathematics, and instruction-following tasks.
The pivot models used were Phi-4 and Qwen-2.5-14B-Instruct.
InfiFusion achieved superior performance while significantly reducing computational costs to only 160 H800 GPU hours.
panels.figure_caption: Performance of models on state-of-the-art benchmarks, with GPU hours estimated on the GPU H800. InfiFusion u achieves nearly identical performance (79.92 vs. 79.96) compared to InfiFusion p &TA, while utilizing only approximately 35% of the GPU hours.

panels.headline: Logits Standardization and Top-K Selection significantly impact InfiFusion u performance.
content: Logits Standardization and Top-K Selection significantly impact InfiFusion u performance.
InfiFusion demonstrates significant performance improvements and computational efficiency across multiple benchmarks.
panels.figure_caption: Impact of Logits Standardization and Top-K Selection on InfiFusion u

panels.headline: InfiFusion is an efficient and effective framework for fusing domain-specialized LLMs.
content: InfiFusion is an efficient and effective framework for fusing domain-specialized LLMs into a single pivot model.
The proposed methods significantly enhance performance and reduce computational costs compared to traditional approaches.
InfiFusion improves knowledge transfer between domain-specialized models by enhancing ULD with Top-K selection and Logits Standardization.
Two fusion strategies (Pairwise Fusion and Unified Fusion) are proposed, each with distinct advantages.
InfiFusion demonstrates significant performance improvements and computational efficiency across multiple benchmarks.
